### Tropicana Atlantic City Celebrates 45 Years of Bringing MORE to the Atlantic City Boardwalk


11/20/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) DOCX](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/2026/Nov/20/Tropicanas-45th-Anniversary-Release-FINAL.docx)


*The iconic resort marks its 45th anniversary this weekend with dining specials* *, a $45,000 casino promotion, fireworks and recognition of 23 opening-day Team Members*


For photos, click[HERE](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/11NWi5Gh3ke9oZaMkMrZqfaTd_6dsQrBp?usp=sharing)


**ATLANTIC CITY, N.J. - (Nov. 20, 2026)** **-**[Tropicana Atlantic City](https://www.caesars.com/tropicana-ac) is celebrating 45 years of bringing MORE to the Atlantic City Boardwalk, commemorating the milestone this weekend with anniversary dining specials, a $45,000 casino promotion and special recognition of 23 Team Members who have been with the resort since opening day in 1981.


From Nov. 20 to22, guests can enjoy throwback dining specials priced at $14.45 at participating restaurants, including Hash House a Go Go, Il Verdi, Chelsea Five and Ossu Asian Tavern. On Nov. 21, Caesars Rewards® members can enter the 45th Anniversary Drawing for a chance to win a share of $45,000 in Free Casino Play, and Tropicana will light up the beach that night with a 10 p.m. fireworks display celebrating the anniversary.


The anniversary celebration also shines a spotlight on the people who have helped shape Tropicana's legacy. 23 Team Members who welcomed the resort's first guests on Nov. 23, 1981 remain with the team today, representing departments across the property with more than four decades of service each.


For 45 years, Tropicana has brought more to the Atlantic City Boardwalk. Since opening its doors on Nov. 23, 1981, the resort has evolved from a casino hotel into a destination for dining, shopping, nightlife and entertainment, welcoming generations of visitors along the way.


From transformative expansions and multimillion-dollar renovations to the Team Members and guests who have made Tropicana part of their traditions, the resort’s history reflects a longstanding commitment to creating memorable experiences and bringing new energy to Atlantic City. As it celebrates, Tropicana is looking back at the milestones that shaped its legacy, recognizing the people who have been part of its journey and looking ahead to even more experiences to come.


“Celebrating 45 years of Tropicana is really about celebrating the people who have made this place what it is today,” said Gregg Klein, senior vice president and general manager, Tropicana Atlantic City. “From Team Members who have been here since day one to guests who have made Tropicana part of their traditions, we’re proud of the memories we’ve helped create over the years. We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who has been part of that journey, and we're excited to keep finding new ways to give our guests even more to enjoy in the years ahead.”


**45 Years of Bringing MORE**


Throughout its history, Tropicana has continually evolved to meet the changing interests of Atlantic City visitors, investing in new experiences and enhancements that have helped shape the resort into the destination it is today.


One of Tropicana's most significant milestones came in 2004 with the opening of The Quarter, a massive expansion that transformed the property with a 502-room hotel tower and approximately 200,000 square feet of dining, shopping and entertainment space. Inspired by the architecture and atmosphere of Old Havana, The Quarter added new variety, giving guests much more to enjoy beyond the casino floor.


In the decades that followed, Tropicana continued to reinvest in its guest experience across gaming and nongaming amenities. Between 2010 and 2018, upgrades included renovations to guestrooms and suites in North, Havana and South Towers, casino floor improvements, new dining, retail and entertainment experiences, the opening of Boogie Nights and the addition of the Chelsea Tower.


Most recently, the resort completed a transformation of its Solana Tower in 2026, introducing 598 redesigned rooms and suites featuring coastal-inspired interiors, contemporary furnishings and thoughtful design details.


Today, Tropicana continues to build on its legacy with an ever-evolving collection of experiences. Newer additions such as Iris Galerie, Zen Spa and Hydrowave Hydration complement longtime favorites like the IMAX Theatre, while programs including the Happy Hour Trail and Trop Loves Locals offer guests and area residents more ways to explore the resort and enjoy added value.


**The People Behind 45 Years of MORE**


Even as Tropicana has changed tremendously over the past 45 years, 23 of the Team Members who welcomed its very first guests in 1981 are still part of the team today, creating memorable experiences and building lasting relationships with guests and colleagues.


Representing departments across the resort, including casino operations, food and beverage, conventions and banquets and facilities and engineering, these longtime Team Members have witnessed the property’s transformation firsthand and their stories are woven into Tropicana's history. For these Team Members, the anniversary is not only a celebration of the resort, but also a chance to reflect on the friendships, memories and experiences that have made their time at Tropicana so meaningful.


**A Lasting Connection to Atlantic City**


Tropicana’s impact extends beyond its casino floor, hotel rooms and entertainment offerings. For 45 years, **** the resort has been an important part of the Atlantic City community, providing local employment opportunities and supporting organizations and initiatives that serve area residents.


Through charitable giving, volunteer efforts and partnerships with local nonprofits, Tropicana and its Team Members have supported causes ranging from food security and education to youth development and workforce opportunities. Organizations including the Community FoodBank of New Jersey's Southern Branch, the Boys & Girls Club of Atlantic City and Covenant House Atlantic City are among those that have benefited from the resort’s community involvement.


**MORE Ways to Celebrate**


As part of the anniversary celebration, Tropicana is offering a casino drawing, a fireworks show and dining specials:


- **45th Anniversary Drawing:** On Nov. 21, Caesars Rewards members can enter for a chance to win a share of $45,000 in Free Casino Play. Members receive one free entry upon activation at a promotional kiosk, plus one additional entry for every 10 Tier Credits earned playing slots, video poker or table games at Tropicana.
- **Fireworks Show:** On Nov. 21, guests can catch the spectacular fireworks show at 10 p.m.
- **Throwback Dining Specials:** From Nov. 20–22, participating restaurants will offer select anniversary menu items for $14.45, including:
- **Hash House a Go Go:** Open Face Hot Turkey Sandwich - Served on a fresh-baked biscuit with griddled mashed potatoes and turkey gravy. Available Nov. 20–22.
- **Il Verdi:** Spaghetti & Meatballs - House made beef and pork meatballs with San Marzano marinara and fresh basil. Available Nov. 20–22.
- **Chelsea Five:** Beef Brisket Platter - Slow-cooked beef brisket with potato pancakes and onion gravy. Available Nov. 20–21.
- **Ossu Asian Tavern:** Teriyaki Chicken Stir Fry - Mixed peppers and pineapple over white rice. Available Nov. 20–21.


**Looking Ahead to Even MORE**


As Tropicana celebrates 45 years on the Atlantic City Boardwalk, the resort remains focused on building upon its legacy with fresh experiences, continued enhancements and more reasons for guests to return.


Among its newest additions is The Lounge Tattoo Co., Atlantic City’s first casino-based tattoo studio, bringing another distinctive experience to the property. Heading into 2027, Tropicana will continue to evolve its offerings while maintaining the fun, value and variety that have defined the resort for generations.


For 45 years, Tropicana has been part of Atlantic City's story. And as the resort looks toward its next chapter, there's still MORE to come. For more information, visit[https://www.caesars.com/tropicana-ac](https://www.caesars.com/tropicana-ac) .
